summary: Comprehensive testing of Net Worth Tracker app. All 14 backend pytest tests passed (CRUD, net-worth aggregation, snapshot/history, CoinGecko crypto pricing, refresh-all). Frontend dashboard loads correctly with hero, donut pie chart (8 sectors), line history chart, 5 seeded assets, category tabs filtering correctly (crypto=1, stocks=1, debts=1), Add Asset dialog opens & creates, Edit dialog opens with prefilled fields, Delete removes asset (verified via toast and DB cleanup), Snapshot and Refresh Prices buttons functional. CoinGecko live price fetched (BTC ~$78,191).

minor.issue: On invalid coin ID returns 500 instead of 404 — the inner HTTPException(404) gets caught by the outer 'except Exception' and re-raised as 500. Cosmetic but inaccurate status code.

For crypto assets the lowercased 'symbol' is used as CoinGecko coin_id (e.g. symbol 'BITCOIN' works only because asset is seeded with that string). A proper field 'coin_id' separate from 'symbol' would be more reliable. Also, all exceptions are silently swallowed (except: pass) — failures during price refresh are invisible to the caller.

issues: Line chart appears as a flat horizontal line because all snapshots have near-identical totals; consider a 'no enough history' empty state or hide the chart until at least 2 distinct-value snapshots exist.

Symbol field shown for stocks/crypto/crypto_projects but for 'crypto_projects' there is no quantity/price field rendered (only manual_value), so the symbol field becomes purely decorative for that category — could be hidden or labeled more clearly.

action_items: (Optional) In /api/prices/crypto/{coin_id}, re-raise HTTPException explicitly so 404 is preserved (currently re-wrapped to 500).
(Optional) Add a separate 'coin_id' field on Asset distinct from 'symbol' to make /prices/refresh more robust; or document that for crypto the 'symbol' must be the CoinGecko ID (e.g. 'bitcoin').
(Optional) Empty/insufficient-data state for the Net Worth History line chart.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 360+ lines but still focused; OK for now. If more endpoints are added, split into routers/assets.py, routers/networth.py, routers/prices.py.
Asset.manual_value used in `value = manual_value OR (qty*price)` — a manual_value of 0 would silently fall through to qty*price. If 0 is a valid manual value, change to explicit None check.
/api/net-worth and /api/net-worth/snapshot duplicate aggregation logic — extract a helper function to compute breakdown+total from assets.
Bare `except Exception: pass` in /api/prices/refresh hides failures; log warnings instead so issues are debuggable.
All endpoints lack response_model on net-worth/prices responses; would help schema documentation.
Frontend correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via process.env, all interactive elements have data-testid, dark theme rendering properly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing 5 seeded assets (Bitcoin, Apple Inc, Savings Account, DeFi Project, Student Loan). Test created/cleaned its own TEST_ prefixed assets via fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_networth_api.py (14 tests, ~2s, all passing). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Net worth calculation: total = stocks+crypto+cash+crypto_projects-debts. Asset value = manual_value OR (quantity*current_price). Bitcoin price refresh from CoinGecko works (live ~$78k). Live snapshot at test time: $35,945.50. CoinGecko 404 path returns 500 due to broad exception wrapping — expect 500/404 either is acceptable in tests.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. All listed items are minor enhancements / code-quality suggestions, not bugs.
